reason: A Windows-only DeepSeek Harness companion that adds a system tray app, standalone desktop window, desktop shortcut, login auto-start, terminal visibility controls, and desktop/Web switching.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Windows 桌面体验，包括系统托盘、独立桌面窗口、桌面快捷方式、登录自启动和桌面/Web 模式切换。
summaries.en: Adds a Windows desktop companion for DeepSeek Harness with a system tray, standalone desktop window, desktop shortcut, login auto-start, and desktop/Web mode switching.

capabilities: Creates and manages a Windows system tray companion
Launches a local Chromium application window or browser window
Configures Windows login auto-start using Task Scheduler or a per-user Run entry
Starts and controls local Node.js and PowerShell processes
Stores plugin state and diagnostics under the user local application data directory
